notes: Account: mid-market product company building an in-product agent for workflow automation.
Primary objective: production-grade chat agents with tool calling (calendar, CRM writebacks, search) embedded in the app.
Performance requirements: interactive feel. Product team wants streaming responses + tool calls; aggregate p99 end-to-end <= 250ms for core path, p50 ~60-120ms for token streaming start.
Cost sensitivity: willing to commit to reserved spend if Dedicated reduces unit cost by ~40% vs hosted at 500k+ monthly tokens.
POC setup: hosted API, 3 model variants (high-quality, balanced, low-cost fallback). Using streaming + function call hooks. Evaluated tail latency and failure modes when KV cache cold.

Key ask: canary/A-B rollout support + automatic evaluation gating on prompt/eval regressions. They want to run automated evals on a 200-sample benchmark and block rollouts if quality drops >2% on intent accuracy.
Quote from Head of Product: "We need deterministic rollouts - if chat accuracy drops when we optimize for latency, we must detect and rollback automatically."

Interest in Redwood features: rollouts (canary + A/B), automatic evals/regression alerts, Optimize recommendations (batching, quantization), streaming + function-calling reliability, prefix/KV caching.
Security: require SSO/SAML, audit logging retention for 12 months, KMS integration for keying, and a carve-out for EU data residency for a subset of customers.

POC findings (summary): - Balanced model meets quality target but p99 latency at 340ms on hosted (above their SLO) - Streaming start latency is low (~80ms) but end-to-end tool-calling (including downstream CRM write) pushes p99 high due to cold KV/cache and network hops - Dedicated/reserved GPU estimate projects p99 < 220ms given model pinning + local KV cache

Next asks from SE/Infra: detailed Dedicated pricing sheet, example canary rollout configs, example eval gating rules + webhook for automatic rollback, and a latency SLO runbook for mixed streaming/tool-call flows.
Blocker notes: legal wants explicit data residency language before Dedicated contract; finance needs 6-12 month commit scenarios to compare against hosted spend.
Action items: SE to share canary + A/B template (by 2026-03-01), AE to send Dedicated tier pricing, schedule security deep-dive (infra/legal).
